audit_reason_required.name: audit_reason_required
audit_reason_required.value: ("audit_events"."decision" IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' AND "audit_events"."action" NOT IN ('company.merged', 'company.unmerged', 'field.overridden')) OR btrim(coalesce("audit_events"."reason", '')) <> ''

campaigns_launch_recorded.name: campaigns_launch_recorded
campaigns_launch_recorded.value: ("campaigns"."status" = 'draft') = ("campaigns"."launched_at" IS NULL) AND ("campaigns"."launched_at" IS NULL) = ("campaigns"."launched_by" IS NULL)

cards_approval_recorded.name: cards_approval_recorded
cards_approval_recorded.value: "cards"."status" IN ('draft', 'rejected', 'blocked') OR ("cards"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "cards"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cards"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL)

source_companies_revenue.name: source_companies_revenue
source_companies_revenue.value: ("source_companies"."revenue_amount" IS NULL) = ("source_companies"."revenue_gbp" IS NULL) AND ("source_companies"."revenue_gbp" IS NULL) = ("source_companies"."fx_rate_id" IS NULL)
